subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Sounds and Spelling – Unit 1, Lesson 3: ie
outcomes: I can say the sound /aɪ/ for ie and read tie and pie.
I can read questions with the tricky word who.
I can ask Is it a ...? and What's this? about toys.

tf.s: The letters ie in pie say /aɪ/.
tf.why: Yes! ie says /aɪ/ like in pie.

tf.s: t - ie makes the word tie.
The word tail has ie in it.
tf.why: tail has ai. tie has ie.

tf.s: We use who to ask about a person.
tf.why: Yes! Who is it? asks about a person.

tf.s: ie and oa make the same sound.
The word lie has ie in it.
tf.why: Well done! l - ie is lie.

tf.s: Who is it? asks What colour is it?
tf.why: Who is it? asks about a person, not a colour.

tf.s: Is it a slide? (a scooter) No, it isn't. It's a scooter.
tf.why: Yes! It is not a slide. It's a scooter.

tf.s: Is it a yo-yo? (a yo-yo) No, it isn't.
tf.why: It is a yo-yo, so we say Yes, it is.

tf.s: The word pie has oa in it.

boxes.q: Which word has ie: tie or tail?
boxes.why: tie has ie. tail has ai.

boxes.q: Who has got the pie? Answer with a...
boxes.why: Who asks about a person, so we say a name.
It is a bike, so we say Yes.

boxes.q: Show a toy. Ask your friend...
boxes.why: What's this? asks about a thing.

hunt.q: Ask about a person: ... is it?

mcq.q: Which word has the ie sound /aɪ/?
Which is the tricky word in this lesson?
mcq.why: We learn who. His and her are revision.

mcq.q: Which question asks about a person?

mcq.why: ie makes one sound, so tie is t - ie.

mcq.q: Teacher: Who has got the pie? Lily has it. You say...
mcq.why: Who asks for a person, so we say Lily.

mcq.q: Your friend shows a scooter. Ask a question.
mcq.why: Is it a ...? asks about a toy.

mcq.q: Look at a picture of a tie. Write the word.
Which group has only ie words?
mcq.why: tie, pie and lie all have ie.

mcq.q: Change p in pie to t. What word?
Is it a doll? The answer is No, it isn't. It's a robot. What is the toy?
mcq.why: The answer says It's a robot.
